description:
# Join Men Earth!

Men Earth is a new Earth server created in October 2025.

The world is made at a 1:4000 scale, so it’s compact but designed to feel complete within that single map.

The current season is S2.

If you explore many places, you might even discover the End somewhere.

There is also an add-on called MakeCountry, which allows players to easily create and run their own countries.

Before joining, please make sure to read the rules.

The rules are available on the Discord server.

[About joining]

We are also recruiting staff.

If you want to help run the server or have technical skills, feel free to apply.

Men Earth supports Minecraft Bedrock Edition only.

If you normally play Java Edition, please switch to Bedrock Edition before joining.
